runner_id.label: Runner
runner_id.description: The Proton or Wine build that runs this Windows game.
use_gamemode.label: GameMode
use_gamemode.description: Feral GameMode sets the CPU governor to performance while playing.
use_gamescope.label: Gamescope
use_gamescope.description: Run the game inside the gamescope compositor.
dx_layer.label: DX layer
dx_layer.description: DXVK translates DirectX 9–11 to Vulkan and is the usual choice. WineD3D uses OpenGL; try it only when a game fails with DXVK.
upscaler.label: Upscaler
upscaler.description: FSR 1 upscales from a lower fullscreen resolution in older games (GE-Proton only).
shader_cache.label: Shader cache
shader_cache.description: DXVK saves shader state between runs, so later launches stutter less. Off sets DXVK_STATE_CACHE=0.
mangohud_preset.label: MangoHud
mangohud_preset.description: The overlay shown in the game: off, frame rate only, minimal, or full.
sync_mode.label: Sync
sync_mode.description: How Wine coordinates the game's threads. Leave the default unless a fix says otherwise.
proton.description: Switches Proton reads at launch. Turn one on only when a game or a fix asks for it.
proton_enable_nvapi.label: PROTON_ENABLE_NVAPI
proton_enable_nvapi.description: Expose NVAPI to the game (DLSS, Reflex on NVIDIA)
proton_hide_nvidia_gpu.label: PROTON_HIDE_NVIDIA_GPU
proton_hide_nvidia_gpu.description: Report NVIDIA GPUs as AMD to work around vendor checks
proton_enable_wayland.label: PROTON_ENABLE_WAYLAND
proton_no_d3d11.label: PROTON_NO_D3D11
proton_no_d3d11.description: Disable D3D11 so the game falls back to another API
proton_no_d3d12.label: PROTON_NO_D3D12
proton_no_d3d12.description: Disable D3D12 so the game falls back to D3D11
proton_force_large_address_aware.label: PROTON_FORCE_LARGE_ADDRESS_AWARE
proton_force_large_address_aware.descrip: Let 32-bit games use more than 2 GB of RAM
proton_old_gl_string.label: PROTON_OLD_GL_STRING
proton_old_gl_string.description: Shorten the GL extension string for old games
proton_log.label: PROTON_LOG
gamescope_resolution.label: Resolution
gamescope_resolution.description: The output size gamescope renders at (-w and -h).
gamescope_rate.label: Refresh rate
gamescope_rate.description: The refresh rate gamescope asks for (-r).
gamescope_filter.label: Upscale filter
gamescope_fullscreen.label: fullscreen
gamescope_borderless.label: borderless
gamescope_grab_cursor.label: force grab cursor
gamescope_hdr.label: hdr
gamescope_hdr.description: --hdr-enabled: enable HDR output (needs the Gamescope WSI layer)
gamescope_vrr.label: adaptive sync (vrr)
gamescope_wayland.label: expose wayland
gamescope_args.label: Other arguments
gamescope_args.description: More gamescope arguments, passed as they are.
eac_runtime.label: EAC runtime
eac_runtime.description: Bind the Proton EasyAntiCheat runtime from your Steam library.
battleye_runtime.label: BattlEye runtime
battleye_runtime.description: Bind the Proton BattlEye runtime from your Steam library.
